stage.name: Abandoned Mine
stage.description:
A remote mine in Ursus where the Infected Patrol Unit are hunting down the Infected. Make good use of the tricky terrain to buy time for the Infected to escape.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally and failing to save an Ursus civilian will result in a penalty of -1 annihilation count.

infected_patrol_captain.name: Infected Patrol Captain
infected_patrol_captain.flavourText: An officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded.
abilities: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

ursus_assault_crossbowman.name: Ursus Assault Crossbowman
ursus_assault_crossbowman.flavourText: An Ursus soldier who is proficient at infiltrating deep into enemy territory. Equipped with a powerful heavy-duty crossbow.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

ursus_mangler.name: Ursus Mangler
ursus_mangler.flavourText: A warbeast trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood.

elite_infected_patrol_captain.name: Elite Infected Patrol Captain
elite_infected_patrol_captain.flavourText: A high-ranking officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded. They are not a part of the army, and are generally despised by Ursus soldiers and city officials alike.
abilities: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

elite_ursus_assault_crossbowman.name: Elite Ursus Assault Crossbowman
elite_ursus_assault_crossbowman.flavourText: An Ursus soldier who is exceptionally proficient at infiltrating deep into enemy territory. Equipped with an extremely powerful heavy-duty crossbow.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

ursus_armored_caster.name: Ursus Armored Caster
ursus_armored_caster.flavourText: A basic caster in the Ursus Army. Clad in simple armor.

elite_ursus_armored_caster.name: Elite Ursus Armored Caster
elite_ursus_armored_caster.flavourText: A basic caster in the Ursus Army who has displayed excellence. They are clad in armor and wield more powerful Arts.

ursus_civilian.name: Ursus Civilian
ursus_civilian.flavourText: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.
abilities: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

ursus_mangler_packmother.name: Ursus Mangler Packmother
ursus_mangler_packmother.flavourText: A warbeast pack leader trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood. Nobody has ever seen a male mangler.

ursus_raider.name: Ursus Raider
ursus_raider.flavourText: Special forces within the Ursus Army that strike a balance between mobility and breakthrough capabilities. Good at fighting underequipped enemy forces.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

agent.name: Agent
agent.flavourText: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.
abilities: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

imperial_striker.name: Imperial Striker
imperial_striker.flavourText: The powerful infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

imperial_artillery_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Targeteer
imperial_artillery_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built drone operated by artillery casters of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery.

ursus_raider_leader.name: Ursus Raider Leader
ursus_raider_leader.flavourText: Captains within the Ursus Army that strike a balance between mobility and breakthrough capabilities, equipped with higher-quality armor. Good at fighting underequipped enemy forces.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

elite_imperial_striker.name: Elite Imperial Striker
elite_imperial_striker.flavourText: The powerful, battle-tested infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction. Along with the Shieldguards, they formed the front line of the Ursus Army.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%
